roles.prior_exposure: Factfinder previously assessed source, eligibility, recording, offline consumer and v1 design. Distinct agents, shared owner.
roles.source_dependence: One NOAA educational source family. Preserve the bounded literal recurrence predicate, seven exclusions, inference, version-specific history, earlier REVISE, source freshness limitation and caller-observed objection context. Prior review does not attest independent empirical replication or current source truth.

prior_split_assessment.staging_design: ACCEPT, explicit offline overlay only; preserve v1 without amendment.
prior_split_assessment.routing_release_criteria: REVISE, addressed in this separate design proposal.

review.canonical_format: UTF-8 compact JSON, sorted keys, ensure_ascii=true.

raw_literal_and_candidate_behavior.scope: Design criteria only. Preserve exact decoded literal precedence, polarity, candidate exclusions and scope controls.

fixture_requirements.R1: For the withheld diagnostic assert answer null, release false and absence of proposed answer bytes. For an isolated authorized-generation fixture after the applicable implementation decisions, assert the separately reviewed answer bytes and exact evidence pins for each of the seven cases, including the declarative negative interrogative and explicit premise and nested rebuttals.
fixture_requirements.R2: Exercise individual and combined case, spacing, punctuation, Unicode, qualifier and paraphrase variants. Include an exact literal extracted from a longer request, and an unrelated eligible candidate in the same pool, then assert no C013 identifier, snippet, score, evidence or answer at both candidate and response boundaries. Compare all 23 complete established lookup responses against the baseline.

generation_consistency_and_reopening.scope: Design criteria only. An authoritative non-reused serving epoch and final validation make stale and reopening behavior testable.

fixture_requirements.G1: Test each generation field mismatch independently, including routing-table digest and record state/version/hash on exact inspection. If a second publisher attempts promotion from the same expected epoch, only one may succeed. Mismatch cases should carry no evidence or positive readiness.
fixture_requirements.G2: Place deterministic assertions on both sides of the authoritative revocation boundary, including an objection recorded while obsolete work is still in flight, a saved response and progress payload with old evidence, and restart with the old index. Verify the objection transition cannot be acknowledged as recorded while a subsequently linearized read can serve the revoked epoch. Assert controlled current pointers and no-store separately from retained immutable bytes.
fixture_requirements.S1: Compare active exports with staging absent and present. When a staged payload is accidentally supplied to active inputs, expect fail-closed rejection with the previously active outputs untouched. Exercise missing and mixed receipts and unresolved objections. Keep ordinary exact inspection and candidates free of C013, while preserving the offline diagnostic's allowed metadata.

intake_consent_and_release_order.finding: The design requires explicit public_review:true and also says no request flag implies consent. This creates conflicting implementation requirements. The proposed release decision order and conditional same-transaction enqueue fence are sound design criteria.
required_revision: State that a Boolean public_review:true explicitly supplied on this eligible unmapped request is the only consent signal. Missing, false or stale replay cannot establish consent. Specify rejection or no consent for non-Boolean values and give preview and blocked literals precedence over any consent flag.

Expand I1 to cover preview with true, blocked literal with true, and unsupported input with absent, false, true and invalid consent. In isolated fixtures require one scoped job for concurrent identical consented retries and conflict without a new effect when payload or consent changes under the same key. Force revocation between initial validation and the authoritative write and require zero stale effects. If enqueue and the generation fence cannot share one authoritative transaction, the expected result is unavailable with zero enqueue.

Carry the existing order forward: exact implementation review and separate curation and routing decisions bound to the proposed generation, then isolated runtime evidence before explicit release, then deployed readback only after an authorized rollout. An offline stage, positive test job or delivered design review supplies no public job, routing or release authorization.

verification.limits: Bounded visible context only. Future runtime fixture families were reviewed on paper and have not been exercised.

limits.history: Preserve prior offline staging ACCEPT and earlier REVISE receipts.

next_action: Prepare an intake-only v3 design erratum. Specify explicit Boolean true as the sole consent for eligible unmapped requests, preview and blocked precedence, false/absent/invalid cases, concurrent same-key reuse, mutation conflict and revocation before fenced write. Bind the accepted v2 sections byte-for-byte and obtain fresh exact review on the revised criteria. Keep C013 withheld.
